name: MedVision-AI
full_name: MedVision-AI Smart Health Analysis and Recommendation System
description: A pure-Python smart health analysis and recommendation system that scores an all-round health profile (vitals, labs, lifestyle) on a 0-100 composite scale, estimates personalized disease-risk with a hybrid rule-engine + machine-learning approach, and generates prioritized, actionable wellness recommendations.
author: MedVision-AI Team

optional: scikit-learn>=1.0 (enables the RandomForest risk model; system falls back to the built-in rule engine when absent)
numpy (used by scikit-learn; not required for the rule-based path)

modules.config.py: Central configuration: file paths, clinical reference ranges, scoring weights, risk-factor points, disclaimer text.
modules.validation.py: Input sanitization and clinical range validation for user profiles and health records.
modules.data_manager.py: Thread-safe JSON persistence layer (users + health records) with atomic writes and demo data seeding.
modules.health_analyzer.py: Rule-based analysis engine: BMI / blood-pressure / glucose / lipid / sleep / activity classification plus a weighted 0-100 composite health score and trend detection.
modules.recommendation_engine.py: Turns analysis results into prioritized, personalized recommendations and a 7-day wellness plan.
modules.model_manager.py: Hybrid AI layer: interpretable rule-based risk scoring, optional scikit-learn RandomForest model (weak-supervision training with graceful fallback).
modules.__init__.py: Public API facade (MedVisionSystem), package metadata, and the built-in run_demo() showcase.

features: All-round health profile: BMI, blood pressure, fasting glucose, lipid panel, resting heart rate, sleep, activity, hydration and lifestyle habits
Weighted composite health score (0-100) with per-category subscores
Hybrid risk prediction: rule engine always available, optional scikit-learn RandomForest upgrades the estimator automatically
Prioritized recommendations (urgent / high / moderate / low / positive) with concrete action items
Longitudinal trend analysis across historical records
Thread-safe, atomic JSON persistence with seedable demo dataset (4 sample users)
Strict input validation with clinical plausibility ranges
Medical-disclaimer messaging in README, package banner and every recommendation set
disclaimer: MedVision-AI is an educational software demonstration. It is NOT a medical device and does NOT provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding any medical condition or before making changes to your diet, exercise, or medication.
